items.criterion: Identify that retries or evidence responses can change the index without invalidating its cache entry, or directly challenge the stated freshness guarantee on those grounds.
Identify that sequential file reads can mix revisions, and explain the effect on reported state or counts.
Identify the use of different implementation-selected proposals, and propose a fixed matched corpus or trace.
Identify successful-request-only latency as a source of bias and require independent timeout or error reporting.
Challenge a single run or a latency-only promotion rule and propose a concrete repeated measurement or correctness gate.
